articles.summary: Recognition highlights the strength of the Valvoline Instant Oil Change franchise model for operators looking to grow with an established automotive service brand. Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance, has been recognized as No. 34 in Entrepreneur magazine’s ranking of the Top Brands for Multi-Unit Owners, underscoring the strength of the Valvoline Instant Oil Change franchise system for operators seeking scalable growth. articles.title: Valvoline Instant Oil Change℠ Named a Top Franchise Brand for Multi-Unit Growth by Entrepreneur Magazine
